tours.title: North Finchley Landmarks
tours.status: publicly available; current access not verified

publishedPoints.publishedName: Brook Farm Open Space / Whetstone Stray
Lodge to Finchley Catholic High School

notes: Map 120.2: complete named heritage markers visible on this map, including points shared with the neighbouring trail and off-line landmarks; road labels excluded. Notes 1–27 and 29–30; number 28 appears on Church End map. Some shared numbers mark more than one feature. This is not a claim that every map marker lies on the recommended green line. No unambiguous start/end or timed narration sequence prescribed.

tours.title: College Farm, Church End, Finchley Village, Victoria Park
tours.status: publicly available; current access not verified

publishedPoints.publishedName: Old Bohemia / New Bohemia / Arcadia sites

notes: Map 120.3 and associated notes: named main heritage markers catalogued; points 63–64 at the map edge refer to neighbouring East Finchley material. Numbered map labels are not a fixed start/order. A marked building can be inaccessible: the author says 30A Hendon Avenue cannot be seen from the road.

tours.title: East Finchley, Coppetts Wood, Victoria Park
tours.status: publicly available; current access not verified

publishedPoints.publishedName: The Grange / Oak Lodge / Simms site
Convent of the Good Shepherd / East End House

notes: Map 120.4 and notes: main heritage points; adjoining southern labels Mutton Brook and Big Wood and western Manor House are comparisons outside the main blue loop. Includes mapped Coldfall Wood alternative. The publication itself repeats marker 61 for two places; names, not numbers, identify our records. Do not turn printed notes into unquestioned factual authority.

tours.title: From Long Lane to Dollis Valley
tours.status: publicly available; current access not verified
notes: Two approximately two-mile circuits or combined four-mile route; optional detours add distance. Published narrative order synthesised from explicit directions, not GPS verification. Two starting station exits; return to station available after part one. Gates and crossing conditions need current checks.

tours.title: Finchley and Friern Barnet green spaces
tours.status: publicly available; current access not verified
notes: All numbered map destinations in stated order (2a Whetstone Stray). Circular, conventionally starts Totteridge and Whetstone station; author permits sections. Index gives 32.7 km; society describes roughly 20 miles. Lettered optional/restricted spaces excluded from main list.

tours.title: St Mary’s guided heritage walk
tours.status: publicly available; current access not verified
notes: 7 June 2024 event: five miles, advertised two hours. Route points are selected navigation/heritage anchors from full directions, not a numbered narrated stop list. Seven-school connection advertised; all school identities not supplied in extracted route. Historical guided event not present booking.

Colney Hatch Asylum / Princess Park Manor

notes: Complete eight audio chapters. Chapel includes Pearly King and circus funeral leads; parachutist identity explicitly uncertain. Private residential estate at end is not general permission to enter. Council warns buggies/wheelchairs unsuitable after point five; cemetery gates matter.

Additional destinations are supplementary, not compulsory stops.

coverageGaps: Complete core landmark map inventory is bounded to three Tony Roberts Finchley sheets; peripheral variants and long walks have selected anchors, explicitly marked.
No paid/unpublished live script accessed; no tour experienced on foot or audio evaluated.
Council main page 403 in direct fetch; indexed text and public PDFs usable. Church End transcript not obtained.
Waylamps access resolved, but schematic cannot verify precise Reiniger location or present pavement condition.
Woodside Park covered by North Finchley/Dollis material; absence of separately found tour is not proof none exists.
Public PDFs are historical guidance, not a current safe-access guarantee. No claimed coordinates, opening hours or visitor standing areas added.
